neighbours.label: a word for a governing or religious institution (church, government, congregation)
fire: Attempts to reunite the divided churches in Asia failed.
Many local governments passed new housing rules.
The old Lutheran church of the town became a museum.
Une dizaine de congrégations occupaient la colline.
Ils réclamaient un gouvernement élu par le peuple.
Councils of bishops and national governments met in Rome.
Her father led a small Baptist church in Georgia.
Le gouverneur et le gouvernement ont signé la loi.
quiet: Attempts to reunite the divided families in Asia failed.
Many local bakeries sold fresh bread on Sundays.
The old brick barn of the town became a museum.
Une dizaine de moutons occupaient la colline.
Ils réclamaient un repas chaud pour le soir.
Pairs of shoes and national flags were sold in Rome.
Her father ran a small candy store in Georgia.
Le boulanger et le facteur ont signé la carte.
